name: aigc-creation
description: AIGC creation platform monorepo developer entrypoint

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate && npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix agent ci
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:agent && npm run test:gateway
scripts.check: npm run check:node && npm run verify:deps && npm run build && npm run test
